mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, r.business_id AS businessId, b.name AS businessName, r.amount, r.quantity, r.pay_date AS payDate, r.office_date AS officeDate, r.pay_method AS payMethod, r.remark, r.create_time AS createTime FROM payment_record r LEFT JOIN shipment_order o ON r.order_id = o.id AND o.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_business b ON r.business_id = b.id AND b.deleted = 0 WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY r.pay_date DESC, r.id DESC
